subject: codebuff
title: 151,832 LOC / 553-file property-asserting corpus with zero public execution: general rule for test mass without runs
evidence: ci.yml:35-55 (public CI = build:sdk + build:freebuff + smoke-binary only); package.json:29 (root "ci" script is build-only); compact-request-budget.test.ts:47+; compact-context-loop.test.ts:265-478
one_why: Mass buys corpus-quality credit (4->5, claw-code row) but only execution crosses 5->6 regardless of size; broken-as-configured CI (amazon-q ledger) sits above never-runs because a defective gate still gates - and here the executed smoke layer (boot-screen assertion across OSes) is genuinely more than nothing, which is why this is 5 not 4.

subject: codebuff
title: Squashed snapshot of a private source tree with honestly-disclosed process boundary - inverted openhands covariate
evidence: git log dfa45d2 'Sync public snapshot from freebuff-private' (sole commit); CONTRIBUTING.md:3,63-67; pr-hygiene.yml:124-131 (FORBIDDEN paths mechanically enforced); docs/testing.md:32 (private test-guard scripts referenced, absent from tree); GitHub API 2026-09-30: pushed_at 2026-09-30T15:10Z, not archived, 13,009 stars
one_why: Agent substance IS in-tree so it gets full in-tree scoring; only the process plane (history, contributors, CI matrix, bus factor) is out-of-tree and gets zero credit/zero blame - durability capped 6 (remote-verified activity creditable, governance unassessable from one squashed commit), and unlike openhands no core lane needs zero-credit treatment.

subject: codebuff
title: Cache-TTL tuning numbers are real measurements but the measurement ledger is out-of-tree and self-labeled private
evidence: common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts:47-62 (87% strip rate, 40x cold-token price, 15-min Luminal TTL, all cited to freebuff-costs.knowledge.md (private))
one_why: Honest labeling is best practice and the mechanism (cache_expiry trigger at compact-history.ts:1066-1110) is in-tree and tested, but a 9-lane claim of 'measured' cannot rest on numbers no reviewer can inspect - this is what separates the token-economy 8 ruling from the provisional 9.

subject: codebuff
title: pull_request_target workflow sanitizes the attacker-controlled PR title before echoing it into a comment, and documents why it must never check out PR code
evidence: .github/workflows/pr-hygiene.yml:15-18 (pull_request_target safe only because no checkout/exec); :68-76 (backtick/newline stripping + 120-char cap - a raw backtick would close the code span and allow a fake approval badge or phishing link posted under the bot's name)
one_why: Every harness that comments PR content it did not author needs this exact threat model stated at the echo site; thresholds are additionally calibrated by replaying the last 300 real PRs (:55-67) instead of importing a convention the project itself fails 17 times over.

subject: codebuff
title: Forced algorithm duplication guarded by a parity test that runs both copies over the same histories
evidence: packages/agent-runtime/src/compact-history.ts:14-23 (why agents/context-pruner.ts cannot import - handleSteps is toString()-serialized and bundled per artifact); __tests__/context-pruner-parity.test.ts (474 LOC, fails on drift)
one_why: Where build constraints force copy-paste of logic, a drift-parity test converts an invisible maintenance hazard into a red build - the honest alternative to either premature abstraction or silent divergence; note it inherits the b1 limitation of running only in private CI.
